subject: Proposed Pod Layering + Performance Harmonization
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Roberts <ellie@compassconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed Pod Layering + Performance Harmonization

Team —

Attached is a proposal to adjust pod layering and align performance calibration across the inference platform org (org_restructure_draft_v3.pdf). High-level goal: reduce duplicated operational ownership across small pods, clarify escalation lanes, and harmonize calibration bands used in performance reviews so managers have consistent signals when making level/bonus decisions.

Key elements:
- Consolidate four small pods into two larger 'feature' pods with a shared infra ownership lane.
- Create a single reporting owner for cross-pod infra (proposed: Karthik).
- Standardize review rubric for levels L5-L7 (calibration-slides.pptx attached).
- Two-week pilot: apply new rubric to one pod for May 10 calibration meeting.

Asks:
1) Please review the attached draft and call out any major red flags by EOD next Wednesday (May 6).
2) Marcus/Laura — impact to current commitments and customer-facing SLAs?
3) Monica/Neha — HR constraints (timing for 1:1s, legal/severance considerations, required comms).
4) Ellie — if you see risks from an org-design perspective, flag those and recommend alternatives.

Comms plan (high level): initial leadership alignment, manager 1:1s, then a town hall. Target public comms week of May 17 if leadership approves.

I flagged the sections where we think headcount or compensation moves are likely; they are highlighted in the draft.

Thanks — I want to move deliberately but quickly so teams have clarity before the end of Q2.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: org_restructure_draft_v3.pdf, calibration-slides.pptx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed Pod Layering + Performance Harmonization

Thanks Steph — quick thoughts after a first pass:

- I support clarifying infra ownership but consolidating four pods into two reduces manager bandwidth and increases span. Need to see a mapping of current ICs to new pods and which individual contributors would report to which managers. Can you add a headcount mapping?
- Customer SLAs: we have three active P0/P1 engagements that were scoped to specific pod owners. We need an explicit transition plan for those customers (owner handoff + overlap period). If we compress the timeline to May 17 comms we risk operational slippage.
- Calibration rubric: looks reasonable, but the L6 promotion bar is still broad. Suggest adding a practical rubric example (recent case) for L6->L7 to reduce ambiguity.

On the upside, I like the single infra owner call — that will simplify incident routing.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Inference Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Thanks for the thoughtful draft, Steph. From People Ops perspective a few practical constraints and next steps: 

- Timeline: if we plan public comms the week of May 17, managers will need a full set of talking points and a sequencing playbook by May 10. HR will need at least 72 hours notice before manager 1:1s for any role changes that include title/comp adjustments to coordinate offers and paperwork.
- 1:1s: recommend a two-step manager cadence — (1) manager 1:1 to explain structural change; (2) follow-up to discuss individual performance/role impacts. We should allow a 7–10 day window between those conversations.
- Sensitive cases: for any role changes that may lead to offboarding we need to loop Legal. We also require a documented performance history for each affected IC before moving to any comp or role action.
- Calibration: People Ops can run a blind calibration panel for L5-L7 to reduce bias; we will need anonymized evidence (last 12 months) and manager notes.

I attached team-roster.csv with a tentative mapping (please review for accuracy) and linked the playbook in the doc list. I will schedule a 45-minute sync the week of May 3 to finalize comms and the manager script — please accept or propose alternate times.

Monica Patel
Senior Manager, People Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: team-roster.csv
